_comment: Independent Camera projection contract (Final Practical Closeout Directive, P2). The production chain's Camera layer maps a director's per-beat camera intent (visual-dsl.json -> beat.camera) to a UNIFORM magnification of the whole composited beat, applied after every element is drawn, as a scale about the canvas centre. This contract is the EXPECTED side; it MUST NOT be imported by the renderer and MUST NOT read the player's embedded BEATS. The renderer animates; this contract adjudicates.
_model_comment: zoom(t) = 1 + amplitude * clamp01((t - start - ramp_start_frac*(end-start)) / (ramp_len_frac*(end-start))). 'static' is identity at every instant. This mirrors the declared production vocabulary (numeric emphasis may push in; everything else stays still).
_purpose_comment: Camera has a production purpose: a deliberate push-in marks the one beat whose core information is a number, so the viewer's eye is drawn to it. It is not architecture for its own sake.

observability._comment: The camera is a single uniform scale about the canvas centre applied to the WHOLE composited beat, so it is observable exactly as the ratio of the composited content extent to the pre-camera scene extent at the same instant. It has no per-element channel: a beat either is magnified as a whole or is not.
